text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Recklessly charging through race after
race isn't
going to make for a thrilling
competition.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing fun about it. All the
results I get
end up feeling the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa doesn't seem to be
enjoying
running in consecutive races. It
might be wise to
consider revising her
race schedule.
